name: Tramontina Fargo cast-iron griddle — 37 cm, 2.3 L
description: The Tramontina Fargo rectangular cast-iron griddle with a pre-seasoned finish, measuring 37 cm with a 2.3 L capacity, provides steady heating and even temperature distribution, allowing you to prepare food with more pronounced texture and flavor. The pre-seasoned finish creates a protective layer against rust and makes it easy to use from the very first meal. Durable and functional, it delivers consistent performance across different recipes, offering practicality and durability for everyday use.

Tramontina Century chef’s knife — 8-inch stainless-steel blade
description: An 8-inch chef’s knife with a forged stainless-steel blade and a polycarbonate and fiberglass handle. The half bolster makes handling easier and allows the entire blade to be sharpened. Dishwasher safe.

name: Electrolux Experience stand mixer — 750 W, 5 L (EKM40)
description: A gray 750 W planetary stand mixer with TruFlow technology and a 5 L stainless-steel bowl. Features soft start, 12 speeds and a pulse function. Includes three mixing attachments and a splash guard.

name: Electrolux Efficient Sport Blender — 320 W, two 600 ml bottles (BSE20)
description: A 320 W personal blender with a stainless-steel finish, two speeds and a pulse function. Includes two 600 ml bottles with BPA-free lids, so you can blend and carry drinks in the same container.

name: Electrolux Efficient 3-in-1 food processor (EFP500)
description: A 300 W food processor for chopping, slicing and grating. Features a BPA-free 710 ml bowl, two speeds and a pulse function. Includes a slicing and grating disc and a chopping blade.

name: Electrolux TruFlow 3-in-1 hand blender — 600 W (EIB20)
description: A gray 600 W hand blender with a removable stainless-steel shaft, TruFlow technology and a turbo function. Includes a mini food processor, whisk and 600 ml beaker.

name: Electrolux Efficient nonstick sandwich maker (ESG20)
description: A sandwich maker with brushed stainless-steel detailing and two fast-heating nonstick plates. Features indicator lights, an insulated handle, non-slip feet and cord storage. Can be stored upright.

name: Electrolux Efficient citrus juicer — 800 ml (ECP10)
description: A citrus juicer with an 800 ml jug and a 30 W motor. Features two cones for different fruit sizes, an adjustable pulp strainer and alternating rotation. The accessories are dishwasher safe.

name: Tramontina Professional nonstick stainless-steel frying pan — 20 cm, 1.1 L
description: A shallow stainless-steel frying pan measuring 20 cm in diameter with a 1.1 L capacity. Features a Starflon Premium nonstick interior and a stainless-steel, aluminum and stainless-steel base for even heat distribution.

name: Tramontina Solar Silicone nonstick frying pan — 24 cm, 2.1 L
description: A shallow 24 cm stainless-steel frying pan with a 2.1 L capacity, triple-layer base and Starflon Premium nonstick interior. Features a heat-resistant silicone-covered handle. Suitable for gas, electric, ceramic and induction cooktops. Dishwasher safe.

name: Tok&Stok Hush garlic press — zinc/gray
description: A Hush garlic press made of zinc with ABS details. Measures 17.2 cm high, 3.5 cm wide and 4.5 cm deep.

name: Tramontina Utilità stainless-steel grater — white handle
description: A grater with a stainless-steel blade, polypropylene handle and protective cover, and a non-slip rubber base. The handle has a hanging hole. Dishwasher safe.

name: A\CASA ceramic planter with chicken pattern
description: A ceramic planter with a red chicken pattern on a light background. Ideal for holding plants, flowers and small arrangements, adding a cozy touch to kitchens, verandas, living rooms and entertaining areas. Its look complements country and farmhouse styles.

name: Linlight acacia-wood kitchen utensil set — 8 pieces
description: A set of eight acacia-wood kitchen utensils, including spoons and spatulas. The smooth surface helps prevent scratches on nonstick cookware. Clean with water and dish soap, and avoid using a dishwasher.

name: Zara Home wooden pepper mill with steel lid
description: A pepper mill with a wooden base, steel lid and steel grinding mechanism. Measures 9.8 cm high, 8.6 cm wide and 5.8 cm deep.
